model_annotation: The chart displays the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity. The pie chart is divided into four slices, representing different levels of ambiguity: clear, somewhat ambiguous, moderately ambiguous, and very ambiguous. The clear conversations slice, colored blue, accounts for approximately 38% of the samples. The somewhat ambiguous slice, colored light blue, represents around 47.7%. The moderately ambiguous slice, colored green, makes up about 14.2%. The very ambiguous slice, colored dark green, constitutes a small proportion. The chart does not include a legend; however, the colors and corresponding labels are listed in a clockwise direction. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of size.
